name: jengo/ai
description: Unified, multi-provider AI SDK and Agentic Engine for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework.

facade.description: Primary static entry point providing fluent AI prompt execution, multi-turn chat, driver switching, model overrides, vector embeddings, structured schema parsing, real-time streaming, and testing fakes.

client.description: Core client manager and driver registry coordinator.

request_builder.description: Fluent request builder with autonomous tool execution loop, schema enforcement, and streaming support.

drivers.name: openai
drivers.description: OpenAI driver supporting GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, o1, o3-mini, structured JSON outputs, tool calling, streaming, and vector embeddings.

drivers.name: anthropic
drivers.description: Anthropic Claude driver supporting Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, multi-turn conversations, tool calling, and token streaming.

drivers.name: gemini
drivers.description: Google Gemini driver supporting Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Pro, structured JSON responses, tools, streaming, and text-embedding-004.

drivers.name: deepseek
drivers.description: DeepSeek driver supporting DeepSeek V3 and DeepSeek R1 reasoning models with OpenAI-compatible API protocol.

drivers.name: groq
drivers.description: Groq LPU ultra-fast inference driver for Llama 3.3 70B and Mixtral models.

drivers.name: ollama
drivers.description: Local self-hosted LLM driver for Ollama (Llama 3.2, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek-R1, Nomic Embed).

drivers.name: fake
drivers.description: In-memory test double driver that intercepts all generation, streaming, and embedding calls for zero-cost testing.

agentic_loop.description: Autonomous multi-step loop executing tool calls and feeding results back to the LLM until completion.

custom_driver_extension.description: Register custom AI provider drivers at runtime.

helpers.name: ai
helpers.description: Fluent helper to start an AI prompt, multi-turn chat, or get the AiClient coordinator.

installers.description: Publishes default AI configuration into app/Config/Ai.php.
